question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Over the trailing four quarters operating cash flow covers net income {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} times and accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, so cash exceeded income. Against the company's own history this is a recovery: fiscal 2025 printed {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, the only year of the six on record where cash fell short of income, with accruals over assets of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}, the highest of the five filled years; fiscal 2024 printed {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}. The trailing ratio now sits inside the earlier range, between fiscal 2021's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and fiscal 2023's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}. Two caveats sit under the recovery. First, the numbers reader shows income taxes paid in the nine months well below a year earlier even though the MD&A says the remaining deemed repatriation balance was paid, and other current and non-current liabilities swung from a large use of cash to a source; neither is explained in the changed text and no calculator field isolates them, so part of the year-over-year cash improvement is timing rather than operations. Second, the quarter's gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of the six filled quarters, includes tariff refunds that the release quantifies and the 10-Q does not; because the refunds are recognised when received they lift earnings and operating cash in the same period. Working capital: over the year receivables absorbed {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} (a share of net income of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct}), inventory absorbed {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}), and accounts payable supplied {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}); payables are the largest working-capital source, with days payable of {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding} against days sales outstanding of {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding} and days of inventory of {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory}, a cash conversion cycle of {ratios.efficiency.cash_conversion_cycle} days. Articulation is clean: the balance-sheet and cash-flow changes differ by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap} for receivables, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap} for inventory and {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap} for payables, each small against the balances. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}: quarterly net income moves less than quarterly operating cash flow, below one, though most of the cash variance is the December quarter's seasonal peak. In the quarter itself operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} exceeded net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, yet income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} year over year against cash's {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct}.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: cash backs earnings and conversion has returned to the company's normal range, but the year-over-year improvement is flattered by tax-payment timing, an unexplained swing in other liabilities and a non-recurring tariff refund

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are not outrunning revenue this quarter: quarterly days sales outstanding of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} is the second highest of the six filled quarters and above the prior quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, but below the year-ago quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, and receivables over quarterly revenue of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue} is below the year-ago {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}; the trailing figure on average receivables is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding} days. The longer history is less clean: fiscal year-end days sales outstanding has risen for three years to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in fiscal 2025, the highest of the five filled years, from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in fiscal 2024 and {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in fiscal 2022, and nothing in the changed text explains it. Contract liabilities move with revenue but more slowly: current contract liabilities are {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} a year earlier, yet their ratio to quarterly revenue of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} is below the year-ago {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} because revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}; revenue recognised out of contract liabilities rose by {note_tables.tables.notes_5.changes.12} in the quarter. Growth is product-led: iPhone rose {note_tables.tables.notes_5.changes.0}, Mac {note_tables.tables.notes_5.changes.2}, Services {note_tables.tables.notes_5.changes.8}, Wearables {note_tables.tables.notes_5.changes.6}, and iPad moved {note_tables.tables.notes_5.changes.4}, the only category down, which the MD&A attributes to iPad mini and iPad Air. The revenue note's wording is unchanged apart from amounts, no new judgment area on variable consideration, principal versus agent or standalone selling price appears, and no extended payment terms or bill-and-hold wording is in the input. Fourth-quarter concentration does not apply to a June quarter. One receivable-side signal: a single customer's share of trade receivables is {concentration.facts.11|pct} at 2026-06-27, up from {concentration.facts.7|pct} at 2026-03-28 and {concentration.facts.3|pct} at fiscal 2025 year-end, while carriers' share fell to {concentration.facts.12|pct} from {concentration.facts.4|pct}; the notes name only the carriers.
revenue_recognition.verdict: no recognition concern in the quarter; a multi-year lengthening of fiscal year-end receivables and a rising single-customer share of receivables are open questions

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The reserve ratios the pipeline tracks cannot be read: no allowance for credit losses, inventory valuation reserve or warranty accrual is tagged at 2026-06-27 or at any comparable date, so thinning cannot be tested. The inventory build since fiscal year-end of {note_tables.tables.notes_34.changes.2} sits entirely in raw materials and purchased parts, up {note_tables.tables.notes_34.changes.0} to {note_tables.tables.notes_34.facts.0}, while finished goods moved {note_tables.tables.notes_34.changes.1}; the components are stated net of reserves but the reserve is not disclosed. No goodwill balance, discount rate or growth assumption is in the input. The effective tax rate over the trailing four quarters is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}; the MD&A says the quarter's rate was higher than a year earlier because of foreign earnings, partly offset by changes in unrecognized tax benefits and share-based compensation tax benefits, and the note table shows the share-based tax benefit rising {note_tables.tables.notes_52.changes.2} in the quarter to {note_tables.tables.notes_52.facts.4}. Changes in unrecognized tax benefits are a reserve judgment that lowered tax expense this quarter; the amount is not in the input. Tariff refunds are recognised only when received, which is the conservative side of an estimate, but they raise income without being quantified in the 10-Q. The legal contingencies paragraph is marked changed with no identifiable change and no accrual amount.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: reserves are invisible in the tagged record; the tax rate carries discrete benefits from reserve changes and equity awards, and a non-recurring refund raises income

cost_deferral.finding: Research and development is expensed: trailing four-quarter expense is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}, and the quarter's expense rose {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.12} year over year, which the MD&A attributes to artificial-intelligence infrastructure and headcount; no capitalised development cost is tagged, and the internal-use software standard the company is evaluating would, if adopted early, begin capitalising such costs from a date it has not chosen. The anomaly is in intangible assets. Gross intangible assets excluding goodwill rose {note_tables.tables.notes_38.changes.0} between 2025-09-27 and 2026-06-27 to {note_tables.tables.notes_38.facts.0}, net intangibles rose {note_tables.tables.notes_38.changes.2} to {note_tables.tables.notes_38.facts.4}, while accumulated amortisation rose only {note_tables.tables.notes_38.changes.1}. No acquisition line is on the cash-flow statement ({terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}), purchases of property, plant and equipment over the trailing four quarters fell to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} from {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure}, and no changed paragraph in the notes or MD&A describes what was capitalised; the numbers reader separately records other non-current liabilities rising over the same span with no breakdown, and nothing in the changed text links the two. The release now prints an intangible-assets line, and the note table shows that line is the non-current portion {note_tables.tables.notes_38.facts.8}, with a current portion {note_tables.tables.notes_38.facts.6} carried elsewhere, which resolves the numbers reader's unmatched figures. The soft-asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, third highest of six quarters, up from the prior quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share}, the lowest, and the year-ago {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share}; the intangible build is the driver. The company publishes no non-GAAP earnings, so there is no gap to widen; the one non-recurring item, tariff refunds, is favourable and recognised when received, and the release does not say whether further refunds will follow.
cost_deferral.verdict: research and development is not deferred, but a large, unexplained rise in capitalised intangible assets with no acquisition outflow is the most material open item in this filing

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: No receivables factoring is tagged in any period and no supplier-finance obligation is tagged, so neither lift the pipeline watches for is present in the tagged record, and the notes diff mentions neither. Classification: the fall in property, plant and equipment purchases to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} alongside the intangible build is a shift in where investment is recorded, and whether the intangible additions passed through investing cash flow or were accrued as a liability cannot be read from the input. Off balance sheet: tagged unrecorded unconditional purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, of which {note_tables.tables.notes_56.facts.0} falls in the remainder of the fiscal year and {note_tables.tables.notes_56.facts.1} in the following year; the MD&A's manufacturing purchase obligations are not tagged, and its other-purchase-obligations figure does not equal the tagged schedule, with nothing reconciling the two scopes. The operating lease liability is not stated in the 10-Q; the calculator carries the fiscal 2025 balance of {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability}. No guarantee exposure and no variable-interest entity is tagged or described. Share-based compensation is a real cost: {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} over the trailing four quarters, {note_tables.tables.notes_52.facts.0} in the quarter, up {note_tables.tables.notes_52.changes.0}; the vesting-date value of the units the note states is larger than the expense booked, so the cost to holders exceeds the charge. It is already subtracted in free cash flow quality adjusted, {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}. Financing is clean: no long-term debt issued ({terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued}), {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid} repaid, commercial paper net {note_tables.tables.notes_41.facts.8} in the nine months, total debt {terms.debt_now} against {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} a year earlier, net debt {ratios.solvency.net_debt}. Non-designated foreign-exchange notional moved {note_tables.tables.notes_25.changes.2} since fiscal year-end, a large change in hedging practice with no explanation in the changed text.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: no engineering visible; share-based compensation and purchase commitments are the real off-statement costs, and the untagged intangible purchases are the open classification question

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: The controls item concludes disclosure controls were effective with no deficiency and no material change in internal control; no auditor's report or critical audit matter is in the input, and no late-filing notice is listed. An officer-change current report dated 2026-04-20 appears in the item-code list with no body, so whether it concerns the chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller cannot be said. The restated prior value the numbers reader found, other non-current assets at 2025-09-27 refiled lower with total non-current assets and total assets unchanged, reads as a reclassification: the release prints a new intangible-assets line for that date, and the note table carries non-current intangibles at that date of {note_tables.tables.notes_38.facts.9}, consistent with the amount that left other non-current assets; values did not change, presentation did. The contingencies paragraph is marked changed with no identifiable change. New prearranged selling plans for the chief executive and the general counsel were disclosed in the quarter; they are not accounting signals but are new against the prior quarter. Nothing on related parties, subsidiary lists or SEC comment letters is in the input. The numbers reader notes that no fact carries a note marker, a pipeline gap rather than a company signal.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: no adverse control or audit signal; one unexplained officer-change filing and one presentation reclassification

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: Of the notes reader's items, the numbers confirm every directional claim about the quarter's revenue, categories, segments, gross margin, operating expenses, operating cash flow, deferred revenue, concentrations, debt and repurchases, contradict none, and leave unresolved the forward-looking warnings on component costs, price increases and tariffs, the services-margin statements, the quarterly tax rate, the purchase-obligation figures, the deemed repatriation balance, the securities maturity profile, the hedge horizon, the equity-award values, and the trading-plan and contingency items, because no calculator field speaks to them. The 8-K release matches the 10-Q on every figure visible to me: revenue {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, net income {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, gross margin {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, inventories {terms.balances_now.inventory}, the intangible line {note_tables.tables.notes_38.facts.8} and the refiled other non-current assets comparative. Two cross-document gaps remain: the tariff refund is quantified only in the release, the 10-Q naming it as a cause without an amount, and the only numbers consistent with it are the Americas segment's cost of sales moving {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.6} while its revenue rose {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.0}; and the release's claim of double-digit growth in every segment is confirmed in direction by all five segment changes being positive, but the double-digit bar itself is not computed.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: release and 10-Q agree; the one quantified non-recurring item lives only in the release

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: quarterly days of inventory of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} is the highest of the six filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a year earlier, and inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} compares with {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory} a year ago. The build is components, not finished goods, and the MD&A's new wording on supply constraints in advanced semiconductors, NAND and DRAM reads as buying ahead; but no reserve or write-down is tagged, so obsolescence exposure cannot be measured. Purchase commitments in excess of need: the MD&A states manufacturing purchase obligations mostly payable within twelve months, which are not tagged, and tagged unconditional obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}; against the quarter's cost of sales of {note_tables.tables.notes_60.facts.11} the manufacturing figure the MD&A quotes is of the order of one quarter's cost, normal for outsourced manufacturing, and the prior quarter's figure is not in the input, so excess cannot be shown. Customer concentration: one customer holds {concentration.facts.11|pct} of trade receivables, up from {concentration.facts.3|pct} at fiscal year-end, carriers {concentration.facts.12|pct} down from {concentration.facts.4|pct}; two vendors hold {concentration.facts.13|pct} and {concentration.facts.14|pct} of vendor non-trade receivables. Channel stuffing: nothing found, since receivables over revenue is below the year-ago quarter, finished goods fell while sales rose, and deferred revenue rose. Circular deals: the vendor non-trade receivables arise from component sales to manufacturing vendors who build the company's products, a circular flow by design in which the gain is deferred until the final product sells; the shares are stable against fiscal 2025 and no investment in a customer that then buys from the company is disclosed.
industry_lens.verdict: component inventory and commitments are rising with no measurable reserve; concentration is stable except one growing customer; no channel or circular signal

anomalies.name: accounts payable growth is the largest working-capital cash source
anomalies.name_ko: 매입채무 증가가 가장 큰 운전자본 현금 원천
anomalies.what: Payables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} over the year, a share of net income of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}, with days payable at {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding}; the calculator holds no payables history, so whether terms were stretched cannot be shown.

anomalies.name: fiscal year-end days sales outstanding lengthening for three years
anomalies.name_ko: 회계연도 말 매출채권 회수기간이 세 해 연속 길어짐
anomalies.what: Annual days sales outstanding reached {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in fiscal 2025, the highest of five years, from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} and {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} earlier; the current quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} is below the year-ago quarter, so no new deterioration, but the year-end trend is unexplained.

anomalies.name: a single customer's share of trade receivables is rising
anomalies.name_ko: 단일 고객의 매출채권 비중 상승
anomalies.what: Customer one holds {concentration.facts.11|pct} of trade receivables at 2026-06-27, from {concentration.facts.7|pct} at 2026-03-28 and {concentration.facts.3|pct} at fiscal year-end; the notes name carriers and vendors but not this customer.

anomalies.name: contract liabilities grow more slowly than revenue
anomalies.name_ko: 계약부채 증가가 매출 증가에 못 미침
anomalies.what: Current contract liabilities rose to {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities}, as the note states, but the ratio to quarterly revenue fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}; growth is product-led rather than subscription-led, a mix point not a recognition fault.

anomalies.name: iPad is the only category down year over year
anomalies.name_ko: 아이패드만 전년 대비 감소
anomalies.what: iPad revenue moved {note_tables.tables.notes_5.changes.4} in the quarter while every other category rose; the MD&A names iPad mini and iPad Air, and the nine-month figure of {note_tables.tables.notes_5.changes.5} is still positive.

anomalies.name: allowance, inventory reserve and warranty accrual untagged in every period
anomalies.name_ko: 대손·재고·보증 충당금이 어느 기간에도 태그되지 않음
anomalies.what: The three reserve ratios are empty in every quarter and year the trend table holds, so thinning or release cannot be tested from the tagged record.

anomalies.name: tax rate lowered by unrecognized-tax-benefit changes and equity-award tax benefits
anomalies.name_ko: 미인식 세무혜택 변동과 주식보상 세금효과가 세율을 낮춤
anomalies.what: The MD&A names changes in unrecognized tax benefits and share-based compensation tax benefits as offsets to a higher rate on foreign earnings; the note table shows the share-based tax benefit up {note_tables.tables.notes_52.changes.2} to {note_tables.tables.notes_52.facts.4} in the quarter, and the trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}. The reserve-change amount is not in the input.

anomalies.name: tariff refunds raise income but are quantified only in the release
anomalies.name_ko: 관세 환급이 이익을 높이지만 금액은 발표문에만 있음
anomalies.what: Refunds are recognised as received, a conservative policy, yet the 10-Q's changed paragraphs give no amount and no tagged fact isolates it; the release alone puts figures on the margin and per-share effect.

anomalies.name: intangible assets rise sharply with no acquisition outflow or explanation
anomalies.name_ko: 인수 지출 없이 무형자산이 급증, 설명 부재
anomalies.what: Gross intangibles rose {note_tables.tables.notes_38.changes.0} and net intangibles {note_tables.tables.notes_38.changes.2} between 2025-09-27 and 2026-06-27, amortisation rose only {note_tables.tables.notes_38.changes.1}, acquisitions are {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}, property purchases fell to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure}, and no changed paragraph says what was capitalised; other non-current liabilities rose over the same span without a breakdown. Capitalised cost of this size is the definition of the cost-deferral watch.

anomalies.name: soft-asset share rises in the quarter
anomalies.name_ko: 소프트자산 비중이 분기 중 상승
anomalies.what: Soft-asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share} against {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share} a year earlier; the fiscal 2025 annual cell {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share} was the lowest of five years, so the quarter reverses that direction, driven by intangibles.

anomalies.name: research and development expense rising faster than revenue, fully expensed
anomalies.name_ko: 연구개발비가 매출보다 빠르게 증가, 전액 비용 처리
anomalies.what: Quarterly research and development rose {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.12} while revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}; the MD&A names artificial-intelligence infrastructure and headcount, and no capitalised development cost is tagged, so the benign reading is that cost is being recognised rather than deferred.

anomalies.name: internal-use software standard leaves early capitalisation open
anomalies.name_ko: 내부사용 소프트웨어 기준의 조기 적용 여부 미정
anomalies.what: The MD&A says the timing and method of adoption are under evaluation; early adoption would start capitalising costs now expensed within research and development, a future shift in cost recognition to watch.

anomalies.name: property purchases fall while intangible additions rise
anomalies.name_ko: 설비투자는 줄고 무형자산 추가는 늘어남
anomalies.what: Trailing property, plant and equipment purchases are {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure} a year earlier, while gross intangibles rose {note_tables.tables.notes_38.changes.0}; simple free cash flow subtracts only property purchases, so where the intangible spending sits in the cash-flow statement determines whether free cash flow is overstated.

anomalies.name: purchase-obligation figures in the MD&A and the tagged note differ in scope
anomalies.name_ko: MD&A와 주석 태그의 구매약정 수치가 범위에서 불일치
anomalies.what: The tagged unconditional obligations total {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}; the MD&A's other purchase obligations are larger and its manufacturing obligations are untagged, and nothing in the input maps one to the other.

anomalies.name: share-based compensation's vesting value exceeds the expense booked
anomalies.name_ko: 주식보상의 가득 시점 가치가 계상 비용을 초과
anomalies.what: Expense of {note_tables.tables.notes_52.facts.0} in the quarter and {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} trailing is a real cost already removed in quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}; the note's vesting-date value is larger than the expense, so the dilution borne by holders exceeds the charge.

anomalies.name: non-designated foreign-exchange notional cut sharply
anomalies.name_ko: 비지정 외환 헤지 명목금액 대폭 축소
anomalies.what: Non-designated foreign-exchange notional moved {note_tables.tables.notes_25.changes.2} since fiscal year-end while designated notional moved {note_tables.tables.notes_25.changes.0}; a change in hedging practice against the company's own past with no explanation in the changed text, not an earnings-quality fault on its own.

anomalies.name: debt and commercial paper paid down with no issuance
anomalies.name_ko: 신규 발행 없이 부채와 기업어음 상환
anomalies.what: Total debt is {terms.debt_now} against {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} a year earlier, with no long-term issuance ({terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued}), repayments of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid} and commercial paper net {note_tables.tables.notes_41.facts.8} over nine months; benign, and consistent with the note's lower carrying amount.

anomalies.name: operating lease liability not stated in the quarterly report
anomalies.name_ko: 운용리스 부채가 분기보고서에 미기재
anomalies.what: The calculator falls back to the fiscal 2025 balance of {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability}; a gap in the tagged record rather than a company change, but it leaves invested capital on a stale lease figure.

anomalies.name: officer-change current report with no body
anomalies.name_ko: 본문 없는 임원 변경 8-K
anomalies.what: An officer-change 8-K dated 2026-04-20 sits in the item-code list without its text, so whether a finance officer departed cannot be said.

anomalies.name: other non-current assets comparative reclassified into a new intangibles line
anomalies.name_ko: 기타비유동자산 비교치를 새 무형자산 줄로 재분류
anomalies.what: The numbers reader found the 2025-09-27 other non-current assets refiled lower with totals unchanged; the release prints a new intangible line for that date and the note table carries non-current intangibles then of {note_tables.tables.notes_38.facts.9}, consistent with a reclassification rather than a change in value.

anomalies.name: contingencies paragraph marked changed with no identifiable change
anomalies.name_ko: 우발부채 문단이 변경 표시됐으나 변경 내용 불명
anomalies.what: The paragraph appears as changed text with no prior wording in the input and no entry in the change history; no accrual amount is tagged.

anomalies.name: new prearranged selling plans for the chief executive and general counsel
anomalies.name_ko: 최고경영자와 법률책임자의 신규 사전 매도 계획
anomalies.what: Both plans were entered in the quarter and are new against the prior quarter; they are disclosure signals, not accounting ones, and no number speaks to them.

anomalies.name: the release's intangible line equals the note's non-current portion
anomalies.name_ko: 발표문의 무형자산 줄이 주석의 비유동 부분과 일치
anomalies.what: The numbers reader could not match the release's intangible line to the tagged net intangibles; the note table splits net intangibles into a current portion {note_tables.tables.notes_38.facts.6} and a non-current portion {note_tables.tables.notes_38.facts.8}, and the release line is the non-current portion.

anomalies.name: tariff refund quantified in the release, not in the quarterly report
anomalies.name_ko: 관세 환급 금액이 발표문에만 있고 분기보고서에는 없음
anomalies.what: The release states margin and per-share effects; the 10-Q names refunds as a cause without an amount, and the only consistent tagged movement is the Americas segment's cost of sales moving {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.6} while its revenue rose {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.0}.

anomalies.name: double-digit segment growth confirmed in direction, bar not computed
anomalies.name_ko: 전 지역 두 자릿수 성장 주장은 방향만 확인, 기준선은 미계산
anomalies.what: All five segment revenue changes are positive, Americas {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.0} through Rest of Asia Pacific {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.4}; the calculator gives no segment growth rate, so the double-digit claim is confirmed only in sign.

anomalies.name: component inventory build with no reserve tagged
anomalies.name_ko: 재고 충당금 태그 없이 부품 재고 급증
anomalies.what: Raw materials and purchased parts rose {note_tables.tables.notes_34.changes.0} since fiscal year-end while finished goods moved {note_tables.tables.notes_34.changes.1}; quarterly days of inventory of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} is the highest of six quarters. The MD&A's supply-constraint wording supports buying ahead, but no management explanation of the build and no reserve are in the input.

anomalies.name: carriers' share of trade receivables falls
anomalies.name_ko: 통신사의 매출채권 비중 감소
anomalies.what: Carriers hold {concentration.facts.12|pct} of trade receivables against {concentration.facts.4|pct} at fiscal year-end and {concentration.facts.0|pct} at the fiscal 2024 year-end; the mix of who owes the company is shifting toward a single named customer.

anomalies.name: vendor non-trade receivables are a circular flow by design
anomalies.name_ko: 공급업체 비영업 채권은 구조적으로 순환 거래
anomalies.what: Two vendors hold {concentration.facts.13|pct} and {concentration.facts.14|pct} of vendor non-trade receivables, against {concentration.facts.5|pct} and {concentration.facts.6|pct} at fiscal year-end; the receivables arise from selling components to the manufacturers who build the company's products, with any gain deferred until the final product sells. Stable and disclosed; no investment in a customer who then buys from the company is described.

anomalies.name: manufacturing purchase obligations untagged, excess cannot be tested
anomalies.name_ko: 제조 구매약정이 태그되지 않아 과잉 여부 검증 불가
anomalies.what: The MD&A states manufacturing obligations mostly due within twelve months, of the order of one quarter's cost of sales of {note_tables.tables.notes_60.facts.11}; no tagged fact or prior-quarter figure is in the input, so commitments in excess of need cannot be shown either way.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름은 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배로, 지난 회계연도의 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배에서 회복해 과거 범위 안에 들어왔습니다. 다만 세금 납부 시점, 설명 없는 기타부채 변동, 일회성 관세 환급이 전년 대비 개선을 부풀렸고, 매입채무 증가 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}가 가장 큰 운전자본 현금 원천입니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 이번 분기 매출채권 회수기간 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일은 전년 동기 {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일보다 짧아 매출 인식에 문제 징후는 없습니다. 다만 회계연도 말 기준 회수기간이 세 해 연속 늘어 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일이 되었고, 특정 고객 한 곳의 매출채권 비중이 {concentration.facts.11|pct}로 커지고 있습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 대손충당금, 재고평가충당금, 보증충당금이 태그되지 않아 충당금이 얇아지는지 확인할 수 없습니다. 유효세율 {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}에는 미인식 세무혜택 변동과 주식보상 세금효과({note_tables.tables.notes_52.changes.2} 증가)가 반영돼 있고, 관세 환급은 수령 시점에 인식돼 이익을 높였습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 연구개발비는 모두 비용 처리되지만, 무형자산 총액이 회계연도 말 이후 {note_tables.tables.notes_38.changes.0} 늘었는데 인수 지출은 {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}이고 이를 설명하는 문단이 없습니다. 이 때문에 소프트자산 비중이 전분기 {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share}에서 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}로 올라갔습니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망금융은 태그된 기록에 없습니다. 주식보상 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}은 실제 비용으로 이미 조정 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}에 반영됐고, 무조건 구매약정 {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}과 설비투자 감소 속 무형자산 증가가 장부 밖·분류상의 열린 질문입니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 통제는 유효하다고 결론지었고 감사인 변경이나 중요한 취약점은 없습니다. 본문이 없는 임원 변경 8-K 한 건과, 기타비유동자산 비교치를 새 무형자산 줄({note_tables.tables.notes_38.facts.9})로 옮긴 표시 변경이 남은 신호입니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K 실적 발표와 10-Q는 매출 {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, 순이익 {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter} 등 확인 가능한 모든 수치에서 일치합니다. 관세 환급 금액은 발표문에만 있고 10-Q에는 없으며, 미주 부문 매출원가 변동 {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.6}이 그와 부합하는 유일한 숫자입니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고일수가 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일로 여섯 분기 중 가장 높고 증가분은 모두 부품({note_tables.tables.notes_34.changes.0})이지만 재고 충당금이 태그되지 않아 진부화 노출을 잴 수 없습니다. 채널 밀어내기나 순환거래 징후는 없고, 고객 한 곳의 매출채권 비중 {concentration.facts.11|pct} 상승만 눈에 띕니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.

dropped_items.reason: calculator_field 'note_tables.tables.notes_38.changes.0' is not a dollar amount under terms. or earnings_versus_cash.
